seo.title: Women's clothing: web store, TikTok Shop and Amazon on one stock count · Coelor
seo.description: How a clothing shop keeps every size in step across its web store, TikTok Shop and Amazon: sold-out sizes pulled everywhere, orders to labels and tracking, returns and restocks back on sale. With a live demo.

hero.headline: Your web store, TikTok Shop and Amazon on one stock count.
hero.sub: For clothing shops that sell the same sizes in more than one place: every order comes off one count, the last size comes down everywhere, and labels, tracking and returns follow without retyping.
hero.gap: The last medium sells during a TikTok LIVE while it is still for sale on the web store and on Amazon. Someone cancels an order and writes an apology.
hero.fix: Every order comes off one count within minutes, and the last size is pulled from every channel as soon as it sells, during live shows too.

hook.headline: Selling clothes in more than one place usually means this.
hook.body: Each row is work someone on your team does by hand today, and how often it comes back. Every one of them is a job the sync takes over.
hook.footer: Recognise two or more? That is exactly the work we automate.

items.title: The last size sold twice
items.body: The last medium sells on TikTok Shop while it is still live on the web store and on Amazon. One buyer gets a cancellation, and the marketplace counts it against you.

items.title: Live shows that oversell
items.body: During a LIVE the stock moves faster than anyone can update the other channels, so sizes keep selling that are already gone.

items.title: New arrivals listed three times
items.body: Each new style is entered on the web store, then again on TikTok Shop and Amazon, size by size and colour by colour, with the photos.

items.title: Orders copied into the label tool
items.body: TikTok Shop and Amazon orders are copied into the shipping tool by hand, and the tracking number is pasted back into each channel.

items.title: Returns that stay sold out online
items.body: A returned dress is checked and back on the rail, but still shows sold out on every channel until someone updates it.

items.title: Restocks counted in size by size
items.body: A wholesale delivery arrives and every size and colour is added to each channel by hand before it can sell.

setup.eyebrow: What we build for a clothing shop
setup.headline: One stock count behind every channel.
setup.body: Coelor sits between your web store, your marketplaces, your stockroom and your shipping tool. It links every size and colour once, keeps the same count on every channel, and moves orders, labels, tracking and returns along without anyone retyping them.
before: Sizes paused by hand after each sale
New arrivals entered once per channel
Marketplace orders copied into the label tool
Returns back on sale online days later
after: One count for every size and colour, on every channel
Sold-out sizes pulled everywhere within minutes
Labels bought and tracking sent back to each channel
Returns and restocks back on sale at once

steps.title: Link every size and colour
steps.body: Each product's sizes and colours are linked across the web store, TikTok Shop and Amazon, so a medium in sage is the same item everywhere.

steps.title: Pull sold-out sizes
steps.body: When a size reaches zero it comes down on every channel within minutes, and during a LIVE on the same run as the show's orders.

steps.title: Move every order along
steps.body: Orders from every channel come off the count, go to the label tool, and the tracking goes back to the channel the order came from.

steps.title: Returns and restocks back in
steps.body: Checked returns and wholesale deliveries go back on every channel at once. Every change can run in test mode first.

faqTop.q: We sell on TikTok LIVE. Does it keep up during a show?
faqTop.a: Yes. Show orders come in every few minutes, and a size that sells out during the show is pulled from the web store and the marketplaces on the same run.
